evidence.why: Derives cpAttr and passes cpAttr - 12 to both write macros.
Macros emit commands and conditionally update indexBase/indexStride.

facts.rationale: Corrects the claim that the function performs no cached-context update: the conditional updates are present in the expanded write macros.
facts.value: Applies the selected array binding immediately through paired GX base-address and stride commands, without setting a dirty-state category. NBT aliases the normal binding. The register-write macros also update gx->indexBase[cpAttr - 12] and gx->indexStride[cpAttr - 12] when that derived index is in 0..3; other array slots do not receive those shadow updates. The function programs an address and stride rather than copying the array contents.

evidence.why: Signature, dispatch domains, post-matrix subtraction, and field widths.

facts.rationale: Preserves the exact signature and parameter roles while distinguishing the post-matrix API ID from its encoded register representation.
facts.value: void GXSetTexCoordGen2(GXTexCoordID dst_coord, GXTexGenType func, GXTexGenSrc src_param, u32 mtx, GXBool normalize, u32 pt_texmtx). dst_coord selects one of eight generator slots; func selects matrix, bump, or SRTG generation; src_param selects geometric, color, input-texture, or generated-coordinate input. mtx is inserted into a six-bit primary matrix-index field. pt_texmtx is a u32 API matrix ID translated as pt_texmtx - 64 before insertion into a six-bit post-matrix field; it is not itself a six-bit API ID. normalize occupies one bit.

evidence.why: Attribute dispatch, normal bookkeeping, and literal dirty mask.
Deferred descriptor emission and XF update.

facts.rationale: Removes the ambiguous phrase 'bit 8' without changing the supported descriptor data flow.
facts.value: attr selects a cached descriptor field in gx->vcdLo or gx->vcdHi, and type supplies its delivery mode. Normal and NBT requests instead update hasNrms, hasBiNrms, and the shared nrmType; the setter reconstructs their shared two-bit descriptor from the surviving presence flags. It then ORs mask 0x8 (bit index 3) into dirtyState. __GXSetVCD later emits both descriptor words and invokes the XF vertex-specification update.

evidence.why: Exact flag selection, counts, packing, and outputs.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes actual attribute counts from the normal/NBT mode encoding.
facts.value: Counts nonzero CLR0/CLR1 descriptor fields in vcdLo and TEX0..TEX7 fields in vcdHi. Separately selects a normal-mode encoding: 2 when hasBiNrms is set, otherwise 1 when hasNrms is set, otherwise 0. It packs colorCount | (normalMode << 2) | (texCoordCount << 4), writes XF selector 8 through GX_WRITE_XF_REG, and sets bpSent to 1. The NBT encoding 2 is not a literal count of two vectors.

evidence.why: Summarizes descriptors and normal flags into XF state.

facts.rationale: Corrects literal-cardinality wording for the normal field while preserving the supported GX subsystem mapping.
facts.value: Realizes GX transform-stage vertex-specification state by summarizing the current VCD as active color and texture-coordinate counts plus an encoded normal/NBT mode. It does not configure component representation or array addresses.

evidence.why: Static signature and packed mode expression.

facts.rationale: Retains the exact signature and field positions but corrects the normal field's interpretation.
facts.value: File-local static void(void) GX state-commit helper. Its packed value places color count in bits 0..1, normal/NBT mode in bits 2..3, and texture-coordinate count beginning at bit 4. Normal-mode values are 0 for neither flag, 1 for normals, and 2 for NBT, with hasBiNrms taking precedence.

facts.rationale: Replaces the misleading normal-vector count description with the mode actually selected by the source.
facts.value: Updates the GX transform unit's vertex-specification register to reflect the current descriptor's active color channels, texture-coordinate attributes, and normal/NBT mode. __GXSetVCD invokes it immediately after emitting the cached low and high descriptor words.
